t_advice_summary_textbox.text: When it is X 1 you will probably get anywhere between 1-7 mushrooms. Pick the colour gnome if there is 1 which consistently gets more than 5. The same colour gnomes usually appear together. If you want to take a risk with another gnome, do it on a X 1 round.

vb_textbox.text: There is no hard and fast strategy for this game. The different colour gnomes change the number of mushrooms they get all the time. Just when you think you have found a gnome that gives you a lot of mushrooms, it can then change to 0 so be mindful of this.
